dedupe_keys.name: derating a single wind farm turbine for reducing its wake and fatigue

description: Astrian, David and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The implemented derating method uses power- and thrust-coefficient contours to minimise turbine thrust while meeting a reduced-power target below rated operation. The reported comparison finds that a constant-pitch strategy performs less well under the examined conditions. This supports turbine operating-point selection and load-oriented control within the specified region. It does not establish the same ordering above rated speed or across every controller. Public executable code and field deployment are not established. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-3.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
